headline: Embraer to Supply Up to Six KC-390 Aircraft to Hellenic Air Force
summary: Embraer signed an agreement to supply three KC-390 Millennium aircraft to the Greek Ministry of Defense, with an option to purchase three additional planes. The first unit will be delivered in 2027.
why: Embraer is a major global aerospace manufacturer and the world's third-largest civil aircraft producer, with significant defense contracts. Defense procurement deals can substantially impact the company's backlog and revenues.

impacts.name: Embraer
impacts.why: Securing a multi-plane military export contract increases forward revenue visibility for the aerospace manufacturer.
